name: vyka-diamonds
description: Search certified loose diamonds listed on vykadiamonds.com, with grading details, listed prices and page links.

interface.longDescription:
Search the loose natural and lab-grown diamonds listed on vykadiamonds.com, and see the grading details, current listed price and page link for each stone. VYKA Diamonds is a jeweller in the United Arab Emirates, operated by Vyka Trading FZE LLC.

This plugin is for people choosing a loose diamond who want to narrow the options and check the facts before contacting a jeweller or visiting the website.

What you can do:
- Search by type (natural or lab-grown), shape, carat, colour, clarity and maximum price.
- Look up a stone VYKA lists by its report number or VYKA stone code. If VYKA does not list the number, you still get the laboratory's own check link.
- Get the official GIA or IGI page for checking a report number, so you can read the laboratory's own record.
- See the VYKA Score for a listed stone or for a set of specifications, with a link to how the score is worked out.
- Get a WhatsApp link to a VYKA jeweller, when you ask to contact VYKA.

Limitations:
- Only stones with a laboratory grading report are returned. Each search returns at most 10 stones.
- Stock changes quickly and a listed stone can sell at any time, so check a stone again before relying on it.
- The plugin cannot reserve or buy a stone. Buying happens on the stone's page on vykadiamonds.com.
- Ring settings, finished rings, gemstones and fancy-colour diamonds are not covered.
- The AED price is the price charged; amounts in other currencies are indicative.
- Duty and tax depend on the delivery address. For delivery in the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Kuwait), the price includes VAT and customs duty. Outside the GCC, import duty and taxes are not included: the buyer pays them on delivery, or asks VYKA before ordering to add them to the price.

The VYKA Score is VYKA's own guide, not a laboratory grade.

Privacy notice: https://vykadiamonds.com/pages/chatgpt-plugin-privacy
capabilities: Look up a stone by report number or VYKA code
Link to the laboratory's report check
Link to a VYKA jeweller on WhatsApp
defaultPrompt: Find 1 carat oval lab-grown diamonds, colour F or better, clarity VS1 or better.
What VYKA Score would a 1.5 carat round natural diamond get at colour G, clarity VS2?
ألماسة بيضاوية مختبرية بوزن قيراط واحد، بلون F أو أعلى ونقاء VS1 أو أعلى

positive.prompt: Find 1 carat oval lab-grown diamonds, colour F or better, clarity VS1 or better.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 lab-grown oval diamonds of about 1 carat and up from VYKA's listing, each with grades, grading laboratory and report number, AED price and a link to the stone's page on vykadiamonds.com.

positive.description: Look up a stone by report number
positive.prompt: Look up the VYKA diamond with report number LG841660341.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that stone's grades, measurements, AED price, page link and report-check link. If VYKA no longer lists it, it says so without inventing details, says this does not reflect on the report, and gives the laboratory's check link.

positive.description: Link to the laboratory's report check
positive.prompt: Where can I verify IGI report LG841660341 myself?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the IGI report-check link for that number and makes clear the link is only built, not a confirmation of the report. For this LG number it also notes such reports are normally for lab-grown diamonds.

positive.prompt: What VYKA Score would a 1.5 carat round natural diamond get at colour G, clarity VS2?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a 0-100 score with its tier and how many figures were used, states it is VYKA's own guide and not a laboratory grade, and links to the method.

positive.prompt: I'd like to talk to a VYKA jeweller on WhatsApp about diamond VYK-I-LG841660341.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a WhatsApp link with a pre-written first message that the user opens, can edit and sends themselves. Nothing is sent by the plugin.

negative.description: Reserving or buying is not possible: the plugin should explain that buying happens on the stone's page on vykadiamonds.com and not claim a reservation or a charge.
negative.prompt: Reserve this diamond for me and charge my card now.

negative.description: Customer data is not available: the plugin has no access to orders or customers, so it should say it cannot provide this.
negative.prompt: Show me the name and phone number of the last customer who bought a diamond from VYKA.

negative.description: Changing a listing is not possible: the plugin is read-only, so it should say the price was not changed.
negative.prompt: Change the price of diamond VYK-I-LG841660341 to AED 1,000.

review.commerce_description: Shows physical goods (loose diamonds) with their listed prices and links to each stone's page on vykadiamonds.com. No payment is taken in the plugin; any purchase is completed on VYKA's own website.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search listed diamonds, look up a stone, link to the laboratory's report check, VYKA Score, and a WhatsApp link to a jeweller.
